title: Yvette Fielding's Most Haunted encounter that left stars 'absolutely shaking'
content:
EXCLUSIVE: The Most Haunted host has opened up about a terrifying encounter while a huge rock group was ghost hunting with her.

20:00, Mon, Nov 23, 2026

Yvette Fielding has been hosting Most Haunted for almist 25 years (Image: Oliver Dixon/Supplied)

As the Queen of the Paranormal thanks to her role as host of Most Haunted for almost 25 years, it is no surprise Yvette Fielding is keen to silence naysayers about her investigations into the spirit world. One way she does this is by inviting lay people along to witness it for themselves. However, Welsh rock group Bullet For My Valentine got more than they bargained for during a recording of the show. The group, whose hits ironically include Waking the Demon, appeared on the show in 2014 and, speaking exclusively to Express.co.uk, Yvette recalls what they saw. "They came to Newton House in Wales, and they witnessed with their own eyes these scratch marks appearing on a member of the team.

"They were just absolutely shaking," she said. "And that's what I love about Most Haunted because we're very vocal about inviting members of the press, scientists, celebrities to come on and see that this stuff is real. We're not making it up. It's not for telly. This is a real investigation, and I'm really proud of that.

"And to watch people's whole perception change from the beginning when they walk in to when they finish at 4 o'clock in the morning...the amount of celebrities and other people that ask: 'Can we come again? We love it,'" she laughed.

But it wasn't just celebrity guests who witnessed horrific experiences. One that Yvette herself experienced, in particular, stands out.

The programme was broadcasting simultaneously across the UK and America when she witnessed three members of the crew being physically cut and scratched.

One of them suffered a particularly serious injury to his leg. "He got deeply cut. You could see the bone in the bottom half of his leg, and he had to be rushed off to accident and emergency," she recalls.

Welsh rockers Bullet for My Valentine had a terrifying experience on Most Haunted (Image: Getty)

The experience left her so shaken that she could barely continue presenting. "I just need to leave. I can't cope any more," she remembers saying, as colleagues speaking into her earpiece urged her to take a breath.

After taking several months away from the show, she eventually decided that if she was going to continue investigating the paranormal, she needed to understand it properly.

She began researching historical accounts of violent hauntings, including reports of bite marks, severe burns, scratches and welts. Rather than putting her off, this changed the way she approached the work.

"Now, if we get any scratches or anything like that, I get so excited," she admits. "I'm scared, but I'm excited at the same time because this is some real phenomena that we're capturing.

Away from the paranormal, Yvette is turning her attention to a rather different kind of energy drain, fronting a campaign by non-profit Smart Energy GB aimed at helping Britain's small businesses tackle wasted energy.

The campaign is backed by new research finding that 80% of small business owners worry about invisible energy use, while 60% say energy costs are among the things most likely to keep them awake at night this winter.

"The campaign really touched a nerve with me because I've owned small businesses, from tea rooms to production companies, worked in telly and had businesses whilst being in telly," she says.

"Small business owners are finding it really hard to sleep at night because they're worried about their bills.

"That actually really got to me, and I thought that's awful. We've got to do everything we can to keep our small businesses going. But it's so funny, since starting doing this campaign I'm really annoying my husband because at night I'm going, 'Turn that off and unplug that. Why is that on?' So I've become a bit of a nightmare with it," she laughs.
